notes.title: Fixed a bug where an achievements could not be unlocked.
notes.content: [p]We have fixed a bug that prevented an achievements from being unlocked.[/p][p]After applying the update, achievements will unlock once the conditions are met again.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]STRIKERS 1945[/i].[/p]

notes.title: Added endings for the arcade version.
notes.content:
Added an ending for the arcade version.
Options Menu > Game Settings > Ending mode
You can now choose between the Consumer and Arcade sections.

In addition, minor bugs have been fixed.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Added the "EXIT" button
notes.content:
The "EXIT" button has been added to the top screen. You can quit the game by using the controller or keyboard.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Fixed a bug with achievements
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented some achievements from being retrieved.

We'll keep checking the forums and continue to update.
And we have some updates in mind.
Thank you for your continued support.
